item.title: Kepa Acero, Natxo Gonzalez, and More Surf Perfect Mundaka
item.description: Kepa Acero, Natxo Gonzalez, and a few friends were lucky enough to score all-time Mundaka in December, and it was the best swell in five years.

item.title: Tom Servais and the Dying Art of Surf Photography
item.description: If surf photography isn't dead, it's certainly on life support. Iconic photographer Tom Servais talks about the state of his craft, and how lucky he truly was.

item.title: Chris Hemsworth Reports Back From a Christmas Surf Trip to Tavarua
item.description: Chris Hemsworth surfs a lot, and well. His latest enviable surf trip was a Christmas jaunt to Fiji's Tavarua Island Resort.

item.title: Telluride Ski Resort Announces Holiday Closure Due to Ski Patrol Labor Dispute
item.description: The Telluride Ski Patrol voted to go on strike beginning Saturday, December 27. The following day, Telluride Ski Resort announced an indefinite closure.

item.title: A Ski Patrolman Caught in an Avalanche at Mammoth Mountain Has Succumbed to His Injures
item.description: Cole Murphy, a patroller at Mammoth Mountain was hospitalized after the avalanche Friday. Tragically, Murphy passed away from his injures on Sunday.

item.title: A Mullaghmore Monster Swell Through the Lens of Tim Bonython
item.description: If you follow surfing, you likely have heard that Mullaghmore was the place to be for big wave surfers in December. Well, one of them, anyway.

item.title: Kelly Slater’s Spaceship Model Debuts in New Proflex Technology
item.description: Kelly Slater is the epitome of a "high performance surfer." Recently he and Mike Woo released a brand new sled called the Spaceship using Proflex Technology.

item.title: Video: This Might be the Longest Chairlift Line You’ll See This Year
item.description: Freeskier Cole Claussen, who posted the video and says it was sent to him by a friend, appears to show the excruciating chairlift line on Saturday, December 27.

item.title: City Officials Remove DIY Solution to Missing Eisbach Wave
item.description: The Eisbach river wave suddenly disappeared in October. Surfers attempting to recreate it have been repeatedly thwarted by city officials.

item.title: Pacific Grove, California Shark Attack Victim’s Body Reportedly Found With ‘Shark Band’ on Ankle
item.description: Last week, Erica Fox went missing at Lovers Point in Pacific Grove, California. A week later, her body has finally been found.
